context: Asuka and Riku visit an old church-like building.
purpose: WIDENED SCENARIO: architecture visit; vocabulary (教会/驚く/引い/っぽい/ただいま) in natural home.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: この建物、教会っぽいですね。
lines.style: curious teen boy voice, soft warm engaged throughout

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: ええ、もとは教会だったんですよ。
lines.en: Yes, it was originally a church.
lines.style: composed teacher voice, soft warm measured informative clarity throughout

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: 中の高さに、驚きました。
lines.en: I was surprised by the height inside.
lines.style: impressed teen boy voice, soft warm wonder throughout

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 天井を引いて高くした、教会建築です。
lines.en: It's church architecture with a raised ceiling.
lines.style: patient teacher voice, soft warm measured informative clarity throughout

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: 線を引いた窓も、きれいですね。
lines.en: The windows with drawn lines are beautiful too.
lines.style: observant teen boy voice, soft warm engaged throughout

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: こういう場所で、静かになろうとします。
lines.en: In such places, one tries to grow calm.
lines.style: composed teacher voice, soft warm measured informative clarity throughout

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: 教会って、不思議な力がありますね。
lines.style: moved teen boy voice, soft warm wonder throughout

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 驚くほど、心が落ち着きますね。
lines.style: warm teacher voice, soft warm measured closing clarity throughout
